light_rays.use: light-ray fan behind the hatch reveal (additive, slow spin)

star.use: little star bits: collect, hatch, level-up

burst_lines.use: impact lines on the hatch crack frame (Rare+)

rune_circle.use: magic circle under a Legendary/Mythic hatch (flat, spinning)

beam_runes.use: Beam texture: rune band on the island-unlock magic circle rings (TextureMode Stretch)
